Boston Dynamics appoints Rohit Prasad CEO effective October 7

The former Amazon AI leader will guide the company’s integration of AI and robotics and its commercialization efforts.

Boston Dynamics / RoboticsTomorrow ↗6 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

A leadership change takes effect

Boston Dynamics announced on October 6 that Rohit Prasad will become chief executive officer effective October 7, 2026. The stated focus is integrating advanced AI with robotics and expanding commercial applications. This is a distinct corporate development from the previously covered Atlas hand announcement.

Experience in AI product development

Prasad previously served as an Amazon senior vice president and head scientist for Alexa and Artificial General Intelligence. During twelve years there he helped develop Alexa and later the Amazon Nova foundation-model family. Earlier, he spent nearly fourteen years at Raytheon BBN Technologies working on machine learning and its applications.

Strategy does not establish new capabilities

Boston Dynamics identifies Spot for inspection, Stretch for box handling and electric Atlas as a platform in development. The leadership announcement gives no new product delivery schedule or demonstrated technical capability. Prasad’s expected board appointment remains subject to approval. Commercial and technical progress must therefore be assessed separately from the strategic intent of the hire.
